result.title: TESS: LLM-guided Translation, Exploration, Simulation, and Search for Embodied Task Planning
result.comment: EMNLP 2026 findings. Code will be released at https://github.com/woyut/TESS_EMNLP26
result.summary: In this work we focus on the problem of embodied task planning, which requires an agent to accomplish a complex task by separating it into atomic actions. Recent studies have developed LLM-based methods to address this problem. However, the executability and correctness of the generated plans remain suboptimal in complex environments and tasks. On the other hand, classical search algorithms have the potential to solve the planning problems perfectly, yet they require fully observable environments, known state transitions and goal state, which are often unattainable in general task domains. Therefore, we propose to implement an LLM-guided search algorithm that makes the search process possible and efficient by incorporating LLMs' commonsense knowledge. Our method leverages LLMs to (1) translate natural language instructions into formatted goal conditions, (2) facilitate efficient exploration in partially observable environments, (3) implement a rule-based world simulator, and (4) prune the space of candidate actions to improve search efficiency. Experimental results on VirtualHome and ALFWorld demonstrate its superior performance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TESS，将 LLM 与经典搜索结合用于具身任务规划：用 LLM 把自然语言指令翻译为格式化目标条件、在部分可观测环境中引导探索、构建规则式世界模拟器并剪枝候选动作，在 VirtualHome 与 ALFWorld 上验证效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「LLM 引导搜索＋模拟器验证＋候选动作剪枝」的框架可能为 LVR 中的推理路径搜索、证据获取与计算分配提供方法线索；但论文面向具身规划而非多模态 latent 推理，迁移价值需核查。
